review_reasons: Requires new mathematics: A rigorous categorical framework for physical phases and emergent degrees of freedom is needed. Specifically: (1) A category-theoretic definition of 'phase' that captures the physical notion, (2) A formal definition of 'emergent' vs 'fundamental' degrees of freedom in categorical terms, (3) A proof that quotient objects exist in the relevant categories of physical systems, (4) Functorial properties of the phase correspondence
